plan.failureSummary: The chatbot backend service at briefcase.chat failed to respond to user messages because the `/api/chat` POST endpoint returned HTTP 500 Internal Server Errors during chat submission attempts.
observedIndicators: Network log entries show multiple HTTP 500 Internal Server Error responses for POST requests to `https://briefcase.chat/api/chat`.
The AI runner marked the objective as not completable because the chatbot failed to generate any output replies to submitted queries.
Visual screenshot and tool history confirm user query submissions resulted in no bot responses in the chat thread.

remediationSteps.summary: Fix HTTP 500 errors on the `/api/chat` endpoint upstream.
remediationSteps.details: Investigate and fix the server-side failure on the briefcase.chat backend for POST `/api/chat` (e.g. check server logs, OpenAI API key configuration, or quota handling).

plan.notes: Network logs confirm repeated HTTP 500 responses from `https://briefcase.chat/api/chat` when attempting to send chat queries, preventing the chatbot from returning responses and causing `page.ai` to fail the evaluation flow.
